summary: The first Astral sanctum altar reaches High Cleric PM_HIGH_CLERIC (276) through sp_lev.c:create_altar -> priest.c:priestini -> makemon.c:makemon. C makemon has no species admission allowlist and creates the high cleric with MM_EPRI; the JavaScript preflight applies its main-dungeon mklev species allowlist because #wizloaddes runs at the hero's current D:1, while priestini does not carry the special-level explicit-monster marker used by des.monster. The source-backed correction is to admit this existing MM_EPRI high-cleric creation path without changing unrelated species gates.

source.branch: An explicit PM_HIGH_CLERIC pointer with MM_EPRI is not rejected by C makemon for being a unique or non-reservoir species. After the genocided check, C ignores propagate()'s return, allocates/links the monster, initializes EPRI because MM_EPRI is set, and continues the ordinary creation tail. The Astral special-level program reaches that branch from its sanctum altar while wiz_load_splua loads onto the current main-dungeon level.
callers: nethack-c/upstream/src/wizcmds.c:wiz_load_splua -> sp_lev.c:lspo_altar -> sp_lev.c:create_altar -> priest.c:priestini -> makemon.c:makemon (High Cleric PM 276, MM_EPRI)
JavaScript: js/wizcmds.js:wiz_load_splua -> js/mklev.js:load_special -> js/quest_levels.js:astral -> des.altar -> js/mklev.js:create_altar -> js/priest.js:priestini -> js/makemon_create.js:makemon
